title: When the Clock Turns
author: Coral Kavanagh
blurb: Astrid Lockridge, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
